question: What identity belongs to the fearsome being arisen from the ocean waters?
premises: The speakers directly address an unknown being.
The addressed being possesses a fearsome form.
The addressed being has arisen in the ocean waters.
inference: The speakers demand the identity of the fearsome being who emerged from the ocean.
plain_english: Who are you? Tell us, O fearsome-formed one—you who have risen in the ocean waters.
